title: CLASP: Continual Low-rank Adapters for Spatially Placed Concepts from One Hypernetwork
title_zh: CLASP：用于来自单一超网络的空间放置概念的持续低秩适配器

paragraphs.en: Continual personalization of text-to-image diffusion models requires sequentially acquiring new concepts while retaining previously learned ones. However, existing methods either suffer from catastrophic forgetting or rely on storing additional concept-specific parameters and spatial components, causing their parameter footprint to grow with the concept stream. This limits their ability to scale to long sequences of personalization tasks. We propose a rehearsal-free approach that uses a single fixed-size hypernetwork to continually personalize a frozen diffusion model. Instead of expanding the model as new concepts are acquired, the hypernetwork dynamically produces the concept-specific adaptations required for personalization while preserving previously learned concepts. Our framework further integrates spatial control into the personalization process, allowing users to specify where a personalized concept should appear without introducing additional per-concept components. This formulation enables continual personalization with a parameter footprint that remains independent of the number of learned concepts, aside from compact concept representations. Experiments demonstrate strong retention of previously learned concepts and reliable spatial grounding, matching or improving upon existing methods while scaling effectively to long streams of personalization tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像扩散模型的持续个性化需要依次获取新概念，同时保留之前已学习的概念。 然而，现有方法要么会遭受灾难性遗忘，要么依赖存储额外的特定概念参数和空间组件，导致其参数占用量随概念流的增长而增加。 这限制了它们在长序列个性化任务中的扩展能力。 我们提出了一种无需排练的方法，使用单个固定大小的超网络来持续个性化一个冻结的扩散模型。 与随着新概念的获取而扩展模型不同，该超网络会动态生成个性化所需的特定概念调整，同时保留之前已学习的概念。 我们的框架还将空间控制整合到个性化过程中，允许用户指定个性化概念应出现的位置，而无需引入每个概念的额外组件。 这种设计使得持续个性化成为可能，其参数占用量（除紧凑的概念表示外）与已学习概念的数量无关。 实验表明，该方法能强效保留之前学习的概念并实现可靠的空间定位，在有效扩展至长序列个性化任务的同时，性能与现有方法相当或更优。

paragraphs.en: Continual learning ( McCloskey & Cohen, 1989 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) considers settings in which models must acquire new knowledge while retaining what they have previously learned. This problem arises in text-to-image diffusion models ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) , where users may progressively personalize a pretrained model to new visual concepts. Personalization adapts a model to a specific subject or style from a small set of reference images ( Gal et al., 2023 ; Ruiz et al., 2023 ) . The model can then generate that concept under new prompts. When concepts arrive sequentially, the model must acquire each new concept without forgetting earlier ones. This is continual personalization . This setting is harder when storing previous training data is undesirable or infeasible ( Carlini et al., 2023 ; Dubiński et al., 2025 ; Verwimp et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 持续学习（McCloskey & Cohen, 1989；Wang 等，2024）研究的是模型在保留已有知识的同时必须获取新知识的情形。 这个问题出现在文本到图像扩散模型中（Ho 等，2020；Rombach 等，2022），用户可能会逐步将预训练模型个性化以适应新的视觉概念。 个性化是指根据少量参考图像，将模型适配到特定的主题或风格上（Gal 等，2023；Ruiz 等，2023）。 这样，模型就能根据新的提示生成该概念。 当概念依次出现时，模型必须在不遗忘早期概念的前提下学习每个新概念。 这就是持续个性化。 如果存储之前的训练数据是不希望或不可行的，这种情形会变得更加困难（Carlini 等，2023；Dubiński 等，2025；Verwimp 等，2023）。

paragraphs.en: Existing continual personalization methods typically store a separate adaptation for each concept ( Dong et al., 2024 ) , so the number of stored parameters grows linearly with the number of concepts. This limits their scalability to long concept sequences. We address this limitation with a fixed-size hypernetwork ( Ha et al., 2017 ) , which generates low-rank updates ( Hu et al., 2022 ) for a frozen diffusion model from a task embedding per concept, kept orthogonal to those of earlier concepts. Thus, the same network can generate adaptations for an increasing number of concepts, with each concept requiring only a compact representation rather than a separate adapter. Because the hypernetwork is updated continually, it can also forget previously learned adaptations. We mitigate this interference with output-space regularization ( von Oswald et al., 2020 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有的持续个性化方法通常为每个概念存储一个独立的适配器（Dong 等人，2024），因此所存储参数的数量会随概念数量的增加而线性增长。 这限制了它们在处理长概念序列时的可扩展性。 我们通过一个固定大小的超网络（Ha 等人，2017）来解决这一局限性，该超网络根据每个概念的嵌入向量生成低秩更新（Hu 等人，2022），用于一个冻结的扩散模型，且这些更新与先前概念的嵌入保持正交。 因此，同一个网络可以为越来越多的概念生成适配器，而每个概念只需一个紧凑的表示，而非一个独立的适配器。 由于超网络是持续更新的，它也可能忘记之前学到的适配器。 我们通过输出空间正则化（von Oswald 等人，2020）来缓解这种干扰。

paragraphs.en: Personalization also requires controlling where a concept appears. Existing concept adapters do not encode spatial information, while storing a separate spatial module per concept would again sacrifice scalability. We extend the same hypernetwork to generate placement tokens, learned from synthetic composites with controlled object locations. At inference time, a user-provided bounding box guides the personalized concept to the desired region without additional per-concept parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 个性化还需要控制概念出现的位置。 现有的概念适配器并未编码空间信息，而为每个概念单独存储一个空间模块又会牺牲可扩展性。 我们将相同的超网络扩展用于生成位置标记，这些标记是从具有受控物体位置的合成组合中学习而来的。 在推理阶段，用户提供的边界框可将个性化概念引导至目标区域，而无需额外的每概念参数。

sents.zh: 个性化还需要控制概念出现的位置。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our approach on the Concept-Incremental Flexible Customization (CIFC) benchmark ( Dong et al., 2024 ) and extend it to sequences of up to 100 concepts. On SD-1.5, we outperform CIDM ( Dong et al., 2024 ) in image alignment at matched text alignment and achieve approximately 4 × 4\times lower forgetting than CIDM and 23 × 23\times lower forgetting than fine-tuning. Along the stream, our method retains the first ten concepts better on average than CIDM at every length CIDM can reach, and it continues up to 100 concepts. We also demonstrate reliable placement, placing seven personalized concepts in their requested quadrants in every evaluated case.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在概念增量灵活定制（CIFC）基准测试（Dong 等人，2024）上评估了我们的方法，并将其扩展到最多包含 100 个概念的序列。 在 SD-1.5 上，当文本对齐能力相当时，我们的方法在图像对齐方面优于 CIDM（Dong 等人，2024），并且遗忘率比 CIDM 低约 4×，比微调低 23×。 在整个流程中，对于 CIDM 能够达到的所有长度，我们的方法平均而言能更好地保留前十个概念，并且这一优势一直持续到最多 100 个概念的情况。 我们还展示了可靠的定位能力：在所有评估案例中，都能将七个个性化概念放置到其指定的象限内。

sents.en: We evaluate our approach on the Concept-Incremental Flexible Customization (CIFC) benchmark ( Dong et al., 2024 ) and extend it to sequences of up to 100 concepts.
sents.zh: 我们在概念增量灵活定制（CIFC）基准测试（Dong 等人，2024）上评估了我们的方法，并将其扩展到最多包含 100 个概念的序列。

sents.zh: 在整个流程中，对于 CIDM 能够达到的所有长度，我们的方法平均而言能更好地保留前十个概念，并且这一优势一直持续到最多 100 个概念的情况。

sents.en: We also demonstrate reliable placement, placing seven personalized concepts in their requested quadrants in every evaluated case.
sents.zh: 我们还展示了可靠的定位能力：在所有评估案例中，都能将七个个性化概念放置到其指定的象限内。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this paper are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 本文的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We propose a continual personalization method in which a fixed-size hypernetwork generates concept-specific low-rank adaptations without storing an adapter per concept.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种持续个性化方法，其中固定大小的超网络能够生成特定于概念的低秩自适应，而无需为每个概念单独存储一个适配器。

paragraphs.en: We extend the same hypernetwork to generate spatial conditioning for user-specified bounding boxes without additional per-concept modules.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将相同的超网络扩展至为用户指定的边界框生成空间条件，而无需添加额外的概念级模块。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our approach on sequences of up to 100 concepts, beyond the 37 that CIDM supports, and show that it outperforms CIDM in image alignment on SD-1.5 and achieves lower forgetting, while maintaining a fixed parameter count.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在最多包含 100 个概念（超出 CIDM 所支持的 37 个）的序列上对我们的方法进行了评估，结果表明，该方法在 SD-1.5 上的图像对齐性能优于 CIDM，且遗忘程度更低，同时保持了固定的参数数量。

paragraphs.en: Continual learning and personalization. Continual learning trains a model on a sequence of tasks without forgetting earlier ones ( McCloskey & Cohen, 1989 ; De Lange et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) , through regularization ( Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ; Li & Hoiem, 2016 ) , rehearsal ( Rebuffi et al., 2017 ; Shin et al., 2017 ) or parameter-efficient adaptation ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Smith et al., 2023 ; Liang & Li, 2024 ) . Diffusion personalization adapts a text-to-image model to a subject or style from a few images, with learned tokens ( Gal et al., 2023 ) , fine-tuning ( Ruiz et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ) or low-rank adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . Continual personalization learns such concepts in sequence, through concept-specific isolation ( Smith et al., 2024b ; Smith et al., 2024a ) , replay or distillation ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Jha et al., 2025 ) , or parameter merging and allocation ( Staniszewski et al., 2025 ; Liao et al., 2025 ) . CIDM ( Dong et al., 2024 ; Dong et al., 2026 ) , whose CIFC benchmark we adopt, keeps a separate set of low-rank parameters per concept, so its storage grows with the stream. CNS ( Liao et al., 2025 ) instead allocates part of the backbone to each concept, which bounds their number by its capacity. We keep the backbone fixed and generate every adaptation with one hypernetwork.
paragraphs.zh: 持续学习与个性化。 持续学习通过正则化（Kirkpatrick 等，2017；Li & Hoiem，2016）、重演（Rebuffi 等，2017；Shin 等，2017）或参数高效的自适应方法（Wang 等，2022；Smith 等，2023；Liang & Li，2024），在一系列任务上训练模型，同时不会遗忘早期任务（McCloskey & Cohen，1989；De Lange 等，2021；Wang 等，2024）。 扩散个性化通过已学习的词元（Gal 等，2023）、微调（Ruiz 等，2023；Kumari 等，2023）或低秩适配器（Hu 等，2022），将文本到图像模型适配到某个主体或风格，且仅需少量图像。 持续个性化通过特定概念的隔离（Smith 等，2024b；Smith 等，2024a）、重播或蒸馏（Sun 等，2024；Jha 等，2025），或参数合并与分配（Staniszewski 等，2025；Liao 等，2025），按顺序学习此类概念。 CIDM（Dong 等，2024；Dong 等，2026）采用了我们使用的 CIFC 基准测试，它为每个概念保留一组独立的低秩参数，因此其存储需求会随着数据流的增长而增加。 相比之下，CNS（Liao 等，2025）将主干模型的一部分分配给每个概念，从而通过主干容量限制概念的数量。 我们保持主干模型固定不变，并使用一个超网络生成所有自适应结果。

paragraphs.en: Hypernetworks and concept separation. Hypernetworks ( Ha et al., 2017 ) generate the parameters of a target network from a compact task representation. In continual learning, von Oswald et al. (2020) regularize the generated parameters rather than the weights of the hypernetwork, and we adopt this output-space view for diffusion personalization. Hypernetworks have also been used for fast personalization ( Ruiz et al., 2024 ) and concept removal ( Wójcik et al., 2026 ) , but not for learning concepts in sequence. Orthogonal Adaptation ( Po et al., 2024 ) , SeqLoRA ( Parsa et al., 2026 ) and InfLoRA ( Liang & Li, 2024 ) instead place the adapters of different concepts in distinct subspaces, so their capacity stays tied to the adaptation parameters. Our network is shared by all concepts, and only the task embedding tells them apart. Appendix A discusses both lines of work in more detail.

paragraphs.en: Spatial grounding. Controlling the spatial location of generated content has been studied through box-conditioned tokens ( Li et al., 2023 ; Lee & Sung, 2024 ) , attention manipulation ( Kim et al., 2023 ) , and regional denoising ( Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ) . These methods primarily provide spatial control for concepts specified directly by the text prompt, rather than for personalized subjects learned from reference images. Mix-of-Show ( Gu et al., 2023 ) extends spatial control to personalized subjects, but relies on retaining a collection of concept-specific adapters. In our setting, adding spatial control should not reintroduce the per-concept parameter growth that limits existing methods. We generate both the concept adaptation and its spatial conditioning from the same compact concept representation, so a user-given box controls placement without any per-concept module.
paragraphs.zh: 空间定位。 通过基于框条件化的标记（Li et al., 2023; Lee & Sung, 2024）、注意力操控（Kim et al., 2023）以及区域去噪（Bar-Tal et al., 2023），研究人员已经探索了如何控制生成内容的空间位置。 这些方法主要对文本提示中直接指定的概念提供空间控制，而非针对从参考图像中学习到的个性化主体。 Mix-of-Show（Gu et al., 2023）将空间控制扩展到了个性化主体，但需要保留一组针对特定概念的适配器。 在我们的设定中，添加空间控制不应重新引入每个概念都会导致参数增长的问题，而这一问题正是现有方法的局限性所在。 我们从同一个紧凑的概念表示中同时生成概念适配及其空间条件化信息，因此用户提供的框可以直接控制位置，而无需任何针对特定概念的模块。

We reserve t t for the concept index. The text conditions the UNet through cross-attention, whose query, key, value and output projections are 𝐖 Q \mathbf{W}^{Q} , 𝐖 K \mathbf{W}^{K} , 𝐖 V \mathbf{W}^{V} and 𝐖 O \mathbf{W}^{O} , and we adapt all four.

paragraphs.en: Hypernetworks. A hypernetwork ( Ha et al., 2017 ) generates the parameters of another network from a conditioning vector. We use a hypernetwork h ϕ h_{\phi} with parameters ϕ \phi , shared across all concepts, that maps a task embedding 𝐯 t ∈ ℝ d v \mathbf{v}_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{v}} of concept t t to the matrices ( 𝐀 t , ℓ , 𝐁 t , ℓ ) (\mathbf{A}_{t,\ell},\mathbf{B}_{t,\ell}) of Eq. 1 for each of the L L adapted UNet projections. The updates of individual concepts therefore need not be stored. Each concept is represented by its task embedding 𝐯 t \mathbf{v}_{t} , which generates its adaptation on demand. When the hypernetwork is trained sequentially, however, updating ϕ \phi for a new concept can alter the adaptations generated for earlier concepts, which our regularizer addresses (Section 4.1 ).

paragraphs.en: Problem setting. We consider a sequence of T T concepts indexed by t = 1 , … , T t=1,\ldots,T , where each concept t t is associated with a small reference set 𝒟 t \mathcal{D}_{t} . Training proceeds sequentially, with access only to the reference set of the current concept. After learning concept t t , the model should be able to generate any previously learned concept j ≤ t j\leq t in response to a natural-language prompt specifying that concept, while preserving its visual identity as subsequent concepts are learned. We additionally consider spatially controlled generation, where a bounding box 𝐛 ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] 4 \mathbf{b}\in[0,1]^{4} specifies the desired location of the personalized concept in the generated image. Concept identity is assumed to be known at generation time.

paragraphs.en: The update should capture the visual identity of the concept rather than the rest of the training prompt, which may describe the surrounding scene. The four adapted projections act on different parts of the model, and each is applied independently at every position, which lets us control where the update takes effect. 𝐖 K \mathbf{W}^{K} and 𝐖 V \mathbf{W}^{V} process text tokens, mapping each token to a key and a value that determine how it contributes to the image representation. Updating them at every token would allow the concept adaptation to affect the entire prompt. We therefore restrict these two to the token positions of the concept’s class word , which is its identifier in the prompt, following the masking strategy of TARA ( Peng et al., 2026 ) , and leave the remaining text tokens to the frozen projections. In contrast, 𝐖 Q \mathbf{W}^{Q} and 𝐖 O \mathbf{W}^{O} operate on image features: 𝐖 Q \mathbf{W}^{Q} produces a query for each image position, while 𝐖 O \mathbf{W}^{O} maps the resulting attention features back into the layer. Their updates can therefore be applied at every spatial position. Only the class word thus reaches the generated update, so we use it as the concept identifier and exclude descriptive attributes from the captions (Appendix E.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该更新应捕捉概念本身的视觉特征，而非训练提示中的其他内容，因为后者可能描述了周围场景。 四个经过调整的投影作用于模型的不同部分，且每个投影在每个位置都独立应用，这使我们能够控制更新生效的位置。𝐖 K \mathbf{W}^{K} 和 𝐖 V \mathbf{W}^{V} 处理文本词元，将每个词元映射为一个键和一个值，从而决定其对图像表示的贡献方式。 在每个词元上执行更新，将使概念调整能够影响整个提示。 因此，我们遵循 TARA（Peng et al., 2026）的掩码策略，将这两个投影限制在概念类别词对应的词元位置上——即其在提示中的标识符，而其余文本词元则由冻结的投影处理。 相比之下，𝐖 Q \mathbf{W}^{Q} 和 𝐖 O \mathbf{W}^{O} 作用于图像特征：𝐖 Q \mathbf{W}^{Q} 为每个图像位置生成一个查询，而 𝐖 O \mathbf{W}^{O} 则将得到的注意力特征映射回该层。 因此，它们的更新可以在每个空间位置上应用。 这样一来，只有类别词会接收到生成的更新，所以我们将其用作概念标识符，并从描述中排除描述性属性（附录 E.1）。

paragraphs.en: Preserving earlier concepts. Although the layer-specific heads separate the generation of updates across layers, all concepts still share the same hypernetwork parameters ϕ \phi . Updating ϕ \phi for a new concept can change the mapping at the inputs corresponding to previously learned concepts, altering their generated updates. We reduce this interference in two complementary ways. First, we assign each concept a distinct direction in the hypernetwork’s input space, so mutually orthogonal inputs represent different concepts. Second, we constrain the hypernetwork outputs at the inputs of earlier concepts, explicitly preserving the adaptations learned for them during subsequent training.
paragraphs.zh: 保留早期概念。 尽管各层特定的头将不同层的更新生成分离开来，但所有概念仍然共享相同的超网络参数 ϕ \phi。 为新的概念更新 ϕ \phi 可能会改变与先前已学习概念相对应的输入处的映射，从而改变这些概念所生成的更新。 我们通过两种互补的方式减少这种干扰。 首先，我们为每个概念在超网络的输入空间中分配一个独特的方向，这样相互正交的输入就代表不同的概念。 其次，我们对早期概念的输入处的超网络输出施加约束，明确保留在后续训练期间为这些概念所学到的调整。

paragraphs.en: Setup. We use the CIFC benchmark of Dong et al. (2024) , with ten concepts (seven objects and three styles) learned sequentially from four to seven photographs each. Unless stated otherwise, results are averaged over three training seeds and reported with their standard deviation. Methods are compared at matched text alignment, and differences below 0.0091 0.0091 DINO are treated as within seed-to-seed variation. We use SD-1.5 unless stated otherwise; results on SDXL-base-1.0 are reported in Appendix I . Further details are provided in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 设置。我们使用 Dong 等人（2024）提出的 CIFC 基准数据集，其中包含十个概念（七个物体和三种风格），这些概念是从每张四到七张照片中依次学习得到的。除非另有说明，结果均基于三个训练种子进行平均计算，并报告其标准差。方法在匹配文本对齐的情况下进行比较，差异低于 0.0091 0.0091 DINO 的情况被视为种子间的正常波动。除非另有说明，我们使用 SD-1.5；SDXL-base-1.0 上的结果见附录 I。更多细节请参见附录 C。

paragraphs.en: Forgetting over sequence of tasks. We measure forgetting as the drop in DINO similarity from each concept’s best score during the stream to its final score. Our method exhibits a forgetting of 0.0060 ± 0.0031 0.0060\pm 0.0031 , compared with nearly four times higher forgetting for CIDM and twenty-three times higher forgetting for sequential fine-tuning (Figure 4 , right). Both CIDM and sequential fine-tuning also learn a separate token embedding for each concept. These embeddings are preserved across subsequent tasks, providing an additional persistent representation of each concept.
paragraphs.zh: 任务序列中的遗忘现象。 我们将遗忘程度定义为：在任务流中，每个概念的最佳 DINO 相似度与其最终相似度之间的下降值。 我们的方法表现出 0.0060 ± 0.0031 的遗忘程度（0.0060\pm 0.0031），而 CIDM 的遗忘程度几乎高四倍，顺序微调的遗忘程度则高达二十三倍（图 4，右侧）。 CIDM 和顺序微调方法都会为每个概念学习一个独立的词元嵌入。 这些嵌入会在后续任务中保留下来，从而为每个概念提供一个额外的持久化表示。

paragraphs.en: Performance on longer sequences of concepts. We extend the stream to fifty and then one hundred concepts using CustomConcept101 ( Kumari et al., 2023 ) . Our hypernetwork has a fixed size as the stream grows and maintains higher retention at all stream lengths reported for CIDM (Figure 6 ). The DINO similarity of the first ten concepts decreases from 0.617 0.617 after ten tasks to 0.557 0.557 after fifty, at the same TA, narrowing the gap at longer streams. The reported CIDM results end at T = 37 T=37 , where its CLIP-based adapter weighting reaches the 77 77 -token prompt limit. Our method continues to T = 100 T=100 , with the first ten concepts retaining 0.531 0.531 DINO similarity.
paragraphs.zh: 在更长概念序列上的表现。 我们使用 CustomConcept101（Kumari 等人，2023）将概念流扩展至五十个，然后扩展至一百个。 随着概念流的增长，我们的超网络保持固定大小，并在 CIDM 报告的所有流长度下维持更高的保留率（图 6）。 在相同的 TA 下，前十个概念的 DINO 相似度从十项任务后的 0.617 降至五十项任务后的 0.557，从而在更长的概念流中缩小了差距。 报告的 CIDM 结果在 T = 37 处结束，此时其基于 CLIP 的适配器权重达到了 77 个词符的提示限制。 我们的方法可继续运行至 T = 100，此时前十个概念仍保留 0.531 的 DINO 相似度。

paragraphs.en: Spatial localization from few-shot concepts. We evaluate placement with an object detector, measuring both whether the concept appears in the requested quadrant and whether its detected box overlaps the target box (Appendix F.1 ). Without the placement module, the box is ignored: specifying the location in the prompt does not improve placement, while a training-free regional layout loses the subject in one quarter of generations. With our module, the concept appears in the requested quadrant in every generation, and 96 % 96\% of detected generations achieve an IoU above 0.5 0.5 . The spatial constraint also improves identity: DINO similarity on the subject mask increases from 0.599 0.599 without a box to 0.717 0.717 with one (Table 6 ). Figure 7 shows two concepts in each quadrant, while Figure 15 shows the complete grid.
paragraphs.zh: 基于少样本概念的空间定位。 我们使用目标检测器评估位置，既测量概念是否出现在指定的象限中，也测量其检测到的边界框是否与目标边界框重叠（附录 F.1）。 如果没有位置模块，该边界框将被忽略：在提示词中指定位置并不会改善定位效果，而无需训练的布局方法则会导致四分之一的生成结果丢失主体。 使用我们的模块后，概念在每次生成中都出现在指定的象限中，且 96% 的生成结果实现了高于 0.5 的 IoU。 空间约束也提升了身份一致性：在没有边界框的情况下，主体掩码上的 DINO 相似度为 0.599，而添加一个边界框后则提升至 0.717（表 6）。 图 7 展示了每个象限中的两个概念，而图 15 显示了完整的网格。

paragraphs.en: We presented a continual personalization framework that uses a single fixed-size hypernetwork to generate concept-specific adaptations for a frozen diffusion model. Each concept is represented by a compact task embedding, while output-space regularization preserves the adaptations generated for previously learned concepts as the hypernetwork is updated. The framework also supports spatial control, allowing the learned concept to be placed within a user-specified bounding box. Across the benchmark, our approach achieves competitive personalization quality while substantially reducing forgetting and keeping the model-side storage constant as new concepts are acquired. These results show that a single hypernetwork can generate the required adaptation for each concept, avoiding the need to store separate parameters for every concept.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种持续个性化框架，该框架使用一个固定大小的单一超网络，为冻结的扩散模型生成特定于概念的调整。 每个概念都由一个紧凑的任务嵌入表示，而输出空间正则化则能在超网络更新时保留先前已学习概念所生成的调整。 该框架还支持空间控制，允许将所学到的概念置于用户指定的边界框内。 在整个基准测试中，我们的方法实现了具有竞争力的个性化质量，同时显著减少了遗忘现象，并在获取新概念时保持了模型端存储的恒定。 这些结果表明，一个单一的超网络即可为每个概念生成所需的调整，从而无需为每个概念单独存储参数。

sents.en: The framework also supports spatial control, allowing the learned concept to be placed within a user-specified bounding box.
sents.zh: 该框架还支持空间控制，允许将所学到的概念置于用户指定的边界框内。

sents.en: Across the benchmark, our approach achieves competitive personalization quality while substantially reducing forgetting and keeping the model-side storage constant as new concepts are acquired.
sents.zh: 在整个基准测试中，我们的方法实现了具有竞争力的个性化质量，同时显著减少了遗忘现象，并在获取新概念时保持了模型端存储的恒定。

sents.en: These results show that a single hypernetwork can generate the required adaptation for each concept, avoiding the need to store separate parameters for every concept.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，一个单一的超网络即可为每个概念生成所需的调整，从而无需为每个概念单独存储参数。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. The method has three practical limitations. First, image quality depends on the number of reference images available for each concept, with fewer examples providing less information for personalization. Second, the hypernetwork has finite representational capacity, which may become a limiting factor as the number and diversity of concepts in the task sequence grow substantially. Finally, performance depends on the underlying diffusion backbone, and the hypernetwork and regularization settings may require adjustment when transferred to a different architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 该方法存在三个实际局限性。 首先，图像质量取决于每个概念可用的参考图像数量，参考示例越少，用于个性化定制的信息就越少。 其次，超网络具有有限的表示能力，当任务序列中概念的数量和多样性显著增加时，这可能会成为限制因素。 最后，性能取决于底层的扩散模型主干结构，而在迁移到不同架构时，超网络和正则化设置可能需要调整。

(2024) are photographed being worn or held. We use both datasets only as released, learn no concept outside them, and release no images of people with the code.

paragraphs.en: Personalization of a text-to-image model is dual use: the same mechanism that lets a photographer re-render their own subject lets someone synthesize a likeness without consent. Our contribution is to learning many concepts in sequence in one network rather than to the fidelity of any one of them, so it does not make a likeness easier to forge than the per-concept adapters it replaces. It does make holding many of them at once cheaper, and a store of a hundred identities in one fixed-size network is easier to distribute than a hundred separate adapters. The placement module of § 4.2 carries the same dual use at the level of composition: placing a subject in a chosen part of a scene is what a photographer wants and also what a fabricated photograph needs. We report both capabilities, including where they fail (Appendix M.2 ), because a reader weighing that risk needs the limits as much as the results.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像模型的个性化具有双重用途：让摄影师能够重新渲染自己拍摄对象的同一机制，也允许他人未经同意合成肖像。 我们的贡献在于让一个网络依次学习多个概念，而非提升其中任何一个概念的保真度，因此它并不会使伪造肖像比其所替代的按概念设计的适配器更容易。 但它确实能让同时保留多个概念的成本更低，而且在一个固定大小网络中存储一百个身份，比分发一百个独立的适配器更简单。 § 4.2 中的定位模块在构图层面也具备同样的双重用途：将主体置于场景的特定位置，既是摄影师所期望的，也是合成照片所必需的。 我们报告了这两种能力，包括它们失效的情况（附录 M.2），因为评估这种风险的读者既需要了解其结果，也需要了解其局限性。

paragraphs.en: Continual learning and personalization. Continual learning studies models trained on a sequence of tasks while retaining previously acquired knowledge, with catastrophic forgetting as its central challenge ( McCloskey & Cohen, 1989 ; De Lange et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . Existing approaches mitigate forgetting through regularization , which constrains changes to parameters or functions important for previous tasks ( Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ; Li & Hoiem, 2016 ; Aljundi et al., 2017 ; Zenke et al., 2017 ) , rehearsal , which stores or generates data from previous tasks ( Rebuffi et al., 2017 ; Castro et al., 2018 ; Hou et al., 2019 ; Douillard et al., 2020 ; Shin et al., 2017 ; Wu et al., 2018 ; Cong et al., 2020 ; Van de Ven et al., 2020 ; Yin et al., 2020 ; Smith et al., 2021 ; Gao et al., 2022 ; Qiu et al., 2024 ; Tong et al., 2025 ) , and parameter-efficient adaptation , which learns task-specific prompts, adapters, or low-rank updates while keeping a pretrained backbone fixed ( Wang et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Smith et al., 2023 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Liang & Li, 2024 ) . Most of this literature focuses on discriminative models, where forgetting is measured by degradation in accuracy on previously learned classes. Our setting instead considers generative models, where each task corresponds to a visual concept, and forgetting manifests as a degradation in the ability to reproduce previously learned concepts under novel prompts. Diffusion personalization adapts a pretrained text-to-image model to a specific subject or style from a small set of reference images using learned token embeddings ( Gal et al., 2023 ) , full or partial fine-tuning ( Ruiz et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ) , or low-rank adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . Continual personalization extends this setting to a sequence of concepts, introducing the additional challenge of preserving previously learned concepts as new ones are acquired. Existing approaches address this through concept-specific isolation ( Smith et al., 2024b ; Smith et al., 2024a ) , replay or distillation ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Jha et al., 2025 ) , and parameter merging or allocation ( Staniszewski et al., 2025 ; Liao et al., 2025 ) . CIDM ( Dong et al., 2024 ; Dong et al., 2026 ) , whose CIFC benchmark we adopt, maintains a separate set of low-rank parameters for each concept, causing its parameter storage to grow with the sequence length.
paragraphs.zh: 持续学习与个性化。 持续学习研究的是在一系列任务序列上进行训练的同时保留先前所学知识的方法，其核心挑战是灾难性遗忘（McCloskey & Cohen, 1989；De Lange et al., 2021；Wang et al., 2024）。 现有方法通过正则化缓解遗忘问题，即约束对先前任务至关重要的参数或函数的变化（Kirkpatrick et al., 2017；Li & Hoiem, 2016；Aljundi et al., 2017；Zenke et al., 2017）；通过重播法，即存储或生成先前任务的数据（Rebuffi et al., 2017；Castro et al., 2018；Hou et al., 2019；Douillard et al., 2020；Shin et al., 2017；Wu et al., 2018；Cong et al., 2020；Van de Ven et al., 2020；Yin et al., 2020；Smith et al., 2021；Gao et al., 2022；Qiu et al., 2024；Tong et al., 2025）；以及通过参数高效适应，即在学习任务特定的提示、适配器或低秩更新的同时保持预训练主干模型不变（Wang et al., 2021；Wang et al., 2022；Smith et al., 2023；Yu et al., 2024；Liang & Li, 2024）。 该领域的大多数文献都聚焦于判别模型，其中遗忘通过先前已学习类别准确率的下降来衡量。 我们的设定则考虑生成模型，其中每个任务对应一个视觉概念，而遗忘表现为在新型提示下重现先前已学习概念能力的下降。 扩散个性化方法利用学习到的词元嵌入（Gal et al., 2023）、完整或部分微调（Ruiz et al., 2023；Kumari et al., 2023），或低秩适配器（Hu et al., 2022），将预训练的文本到图像模型适配到由少量参考图像构成的特定主体或风格上。 持续个性化方法将这一设定扩展到一系列概念，由此带来了额外挑战：在获取新概念的同时保留先前已学习的概念。 现有方法通过概念特异性隔离（Smith et al., 2024b；Smith et al., 2024a）、重播或蒸馏（Sun et al., 2024；Jha et al., 2025），以及参数合并或分配（Staniszewski et al., 2025；Liao et al., 2025）来解决这一问题。 CIDM（Dong et al., 2024；Dong et al., 2026）采用了我们使用的CIFC基准测试，它为每个概念维护一组独立的低秩参数，导致其参数存储量随序列长度增长而增加。

sents.en: Existing approaches address this through concept-specific isolation ( Smith et al., 2024b ; Smith et al., 2024a ) , replay or distillation ( Sun et al., 2024 ; Jha et al., 2025 ) , and parameter merging or allocation ( Staniszewski et al., 2025 ; Liao et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 现有方法通过概念特异性隔离（Smith et al., 2024b；Smith et al., 2024a）、重播或蒸馏（Sun et al., 2024；Jha et al., 2025），以及参数合并或分配（Staniszewski et al., 2025；Liao et al., 2025）来解决这一问题。

sents.en: CIDM ( Dong et al., 2024 ; Dong et al., 2026 ) , whose CIFC benchmark we adopt, maintains a separate set of low-rank parameters for each concept, causing its parameter storage to grow with the sequence length.
sents.zh: CIDM（Dong et al., 2024；Dong et al., 2026）采用了我们使用的CIFC基准测试，它为每个概念维护一组独立的低秩参数，导致其参数存储量随序列长度增长而增加。

paragraphs.en: CNS ( Liao et al., 2025 ) avoids this growing storage by allocating subsets of the backbone to individual concepts, but consequently limits the number of concepts by the available parameter capacity. Our approach instead keeps the diffusion backbone fixed and uses a single hypernetwork to generate concept-specific adaptations for an increasing number of concepts.
paragraphs.zh: CNS（Liao 等人，2025）通过将主干网络的子集分配给各个概念来避免这种存储需求的增长，但因此可用参数容量会限制可处理的概念数量。 我们的方法则保持扩散主干网络固定不变，并使用一个单一的超网络为不断增长的概念数量生成特定的概念适配。

sents.en: CNS ( Liao et al., 2025 ) avoids this growing storage by allocating subsets of the backbone to individual concepts, but consequently limits the number of concepts by the available parameter capacity.
sents.zh: CNS（Liao 等人，2025）通过将主干网络的子集分配给各个概念来避免这种存储需求的增长，但因此可用参数容量会限制可处理的概念数量。

sents.en: Our approach instead keeps the diffusion backbone fixed and uses a single hypernetwork to generate concept-specific adaptations for an increasing number of concepts.
sents.zh: 我们的方法则保持扩散主干网络固定不变，并使用一个单一的超网络为不断增长的概念数量生成特定的概念适配。

paragraphs.en: Hypernetworks and concept separation. Hypernetworks ( Ha et al., 2017 ) generate the parameters of a target network conditioned on a compact task representation. In continual learning, von Oswald et al. (2020) show that regularizing changes in the generated parameters, rather than the hypernetwork weights themselves, can substantially reduce forgetting. We adopt this output-space perspective for continual diffusion personalization. Hypernetworks have also been explored for fast diffusion personalization ( Ruiz et al., 2024 ) and concept removal ( Wójcik et al., 2026 ) , but these methods do not consider sequential acquisition of concepts or the interference that arises when a shared hypernetwork is repeatedly updated. A complementary line of work addresses concept interference by separating concept-specific adaptations in weight space. Orthogonal Adaptation ( Po et al., 2024 ) and SeqLoRA ( Parsa et al., 2026 ) constrain adapters of different concepts to occupy distinct subspaces, while related interference-free low-rank adaptation has been studied in discriminative continual learning ( Liang & Li, 2024 ) . These approaches separate concepts directly in parameter space, so the capacity for storing distinct concepts remains tied to the available adaptation parameters. In contrast, our method uses a single hypernetwork shared across all concepts. Each concept is represented by a distinct task embedding, allowing the hypernetwork to generate a different adaptation for each concept while keeping its own size fixed. TARA ( Peng et al., 2026 ) addresses a different source of interference by restricting a concept-specific update to the token positions associated with that concept, rather than allowing it to affect the entire prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 超网络与概念分离。 超网络（Ha 等人，2017）根据紧凑的任务表示生成目标网络的参数。 在持续学习中，von Oswald 等人 （2020）指出，对生成的参数变化进行正则化，而非对超网络权重本身进行正则化，可以显著减少遗忘现象。 我们在持续扩散个性化中采用了这种输出空间视角。 超网络也被用于快速扩散个性化（Ruiz 等人，2024）和概念移除（Wójcik 等人，2026），但这些方法并未考虑概念的序列获取，也未考虑共享超网络在重复更新时产生的干扰。 另一条互补的研究路线通过在权重空间中分离特定于每个概念的适应性调整来解决概念干扰问题。 正交自适应（Po 等人，2024）和 SeqLoRA（Parsa 等人，2026）将不同概念的适配器限制在各自独立的子空间中，而相关的无干扰低秩自适应方法已在判别式持续学习中被研究过（Liang & Li，2024）。 这些方法直接在参数空间中分离概念，因此存储不同概念的能力仍然受可用自适应参数的限制。 相比之下，我们的方法使用一个在所有概念间共享的单一超网络。 每个概念由一个独特的任务嵌入表示，这使得超网络能够在保持自身大小不变的同时，为每个概念生成不同的适应性调整。 TARA（Peng 等人，2026）通过限制特定于某个概念的更新仅作用于与该概念相关的词元位置，而非允许其影响整个提示，来解决另一种干扰来源。

paragraphs.en: We use two backbones, SD-1.5 at 512 2 512^{2} and SDXL-base-1.0 at 1024 2 1024^{2} . The UNet, the VAE and the text encoders are frozen, and only the hypernetwork trains. The content heads account for 21.9 21.9 M and 167.5 167.5 M of them, over L = 64 L=64 and L = 280 L=280 adapted layers, and the placement module for the remaining 4.1 4.1 M and 23.5 23.5 M. SD-1.5 conditions its cross-attention on the last hidden state of a CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , of width 768 768 , which is also the width of the placement tokens. SDXL-base-1.0 conditions on the concatenated penultimate hidden states of its two text encoders and on the pooled projection of the second, of width 1280 1280 .

paragraphs.en: Each task is trained for 800 800 steps with batch size 2 2 , AdamW at learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} and weight decay 10 − 2 10^{-2} , and the lookahead rate η = 10 − 4 \eta=10^{-4} . Following von Oswald et al. (2020) , the output-space regularizer of Eq. 6 is evaluated at the lookahead parameters ϕ − η ​ ∇ ϕ ℒ rec \phi-\eta\nabla_{\phi}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rec}} rather than at ϕ \phi . The regularizer weight is β = 7120 \beta=7120 on SD-1.5 and β = 3000 \beta=3000 on SDXL. paragraphs.zh: 每个任务均训练 800 步，批量大小为 2，使用 AdamW 优化器，学习率为 $10^{-4}$，权重衰减为 $10^{-2}$，前瞻率 $\eta = 10^{-4}$。遵循 von Oswald 等人（2020）的做法，公式 6 中的输出空间正则化项是在前瞻参数 $\phi-\eta\nabla_{\phi}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rec}}$ 处进行评估，而非在 $\phi$ 处。正则化权重在 SD-1.5 上为 $\beta = 7120$，在 SDXL 上为 $\beta = 3000$。这是唯一未在这两种主干网络之间迁移的超参数，附录 I 展示了将其保持不变所带来的影响。超网络以 fp32 格式进行训练。在 SD-1.5 上，冻结的主干网络保持 fp32 格式；在 SDXL 上则使用 bf16 格式；而 VAE 在两种模型中均使用 fp32 格式。

Each head consists of two two-layer MLPs of hidden width 50 50 , one per factor, and each layer has a learned scalar gain folded into 𝐀 \mathbf{A} . Every linear layer of a head draws its weights and biases uniformly from [ − 1 / n in , 1 / n in ] [-1/\sqrt{n_{\mathrm{in}}},1/\sqrt{n_{\mathrm{in}}}] (the default of a PyTorch linear layer), with n in n_{\mathrm{in}} its input width ( 256 256 for the first layer, 50 50 for the second). paragraphs.en: The placement branch cannot be trained on the concept’s photographs alone. In a photograph the subject is wherever it happens to be, and the noisy latent already reveals that, so the box adds no information. On half of the training steps we therefore replace the photograph with a composite, and only in the high-noise half of the schedule, s ∈ [ S / 2 , S ) s\in[S/2,S) , where layout is decided and the appearance of the composite is not yet resolved. To build a composite, we segment the subject, shrink its alpha matte by three pixels, and paste it onto one of about one hundred backgrounds synthesized once by the frozen backbone, where it covers 45 % 45\% to 85 % 85\% of the frame’s long side. Without the shrink, the soft edge carries the source background into the composite, and at inference it appears as a rim around every subject. The benchmark’s seven object concepts are segmented with ISNet ( Qin et al., 2022 ) , and the added concepts with Grounding-DINO boxes for the class word refined by SAM ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Kirillov et al., 2023 ) . For the 45 45 of 515 515 photographs where the automatic mask failed, we chose among the candidate masks by hand and recorded the choice. The remaining training steps use the concept’s own photographs, with a random square crop of 80 80 to 100 % 100\% of the short side and a random horizontal flip.
paragraphs.zh: 布局分支不能仅基于该概念的照片进行训练。 在照片中，主体位于其实际出现的位置，而含噪潜在变量已经揭示了这一点，因此添加的框并未提供任何额外信息。 因此，在训练步骤的一半中，我们将照片替换为合成图像，且仅在训练进度的高噪声阶段（s ∈ [S/2, S)），此时布局已确定，但合成图像的外观尚未最终确定。 为了构建合成图像，我们对主体进行分割，将其透明度遮罩缩小三个像素，然后将其粘贴到由冻结主干网络预先合成的约一百个背景之一上，使其覆盖画面长边的 45% 至 85%。 如果不进行缩小操作，柔和的边缘会将原始背景带入合成图像中，在推理阶段则会表现为每个主体周围的边缘轮廓。 该基准测试中的七个物体概念使用 ISNet（Qin et al., 2022）进行分割，而新增的概念则使用 Grounding-DINO 框进行分割，其类别词由 SAM（Liu et al., 2024; Kirillov et al., 2023）进行优化。 在 515 张照片中，有 45 张的自动掩码生成失败，因此我们手动从候选掩码中选择，并记录了选择结果。 其余的训练步骤使用该概念自身的照片，并对图像进行随机方形裁剪（短边的 80% 至 100%），以及随机水平翻转。

sents.zh: 布局分支不能仅基于该概念的照片进行训练。

sents.zh: 因此，在训练步骤的一半中，我们将照片替换为合成图像，且仅在训练进度的高噪声阶段（s ∈ [S/2, S)），此时布局已确定，但合成图像的外观尚未最终确定。

sents.zh: 该基准测试中的七个物体概念使用 ISNet（Qin et al., 2022）进行分割，而新增的概念则使用 Grounding-DINO 框进行分割，其类别词由 SAM（Liu et al., 2024; Kirillov et al., 2023）进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Generation uses 50 50 denoising steps at guidance 7.5 7.5 , and for evaluation we draw ten images per prompt. Bootstrapping, in the manner of MultiDiffusion ( Bar-Tal et al., 2023 ) , replaces everything outside the box by a background latent for the first K K steps, so the subject can form only inside it. With a box, unless stated otherwise, the gain is κ = 2 \kappa=2 , bootstrapping covers the first K = 15 K=15 steps, and s lora = 0.7 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.7 . The generated adapters and the attention branch enter only the conditional pass of classifier-free guidance, and the unconditional pass runs the frozen backbone, so guidance amplifies both like any other condition. The gain schedule and the bootstrap each span the first 30 % 30\% of the denoising steps. The background latent is generated in ten steps with both modules off, so it agrees with the scene and needs no pre-rendered images. The box is dilated by three latent cells before the replacement. The replacement mask of the bootstrap is binary, because blending two noise draws leaves the input under-noised for its timestep and desaturates the output.
paragraphs.zh: 生成过程使用 50 个去噪步骤和 7.5 的指导系数，评估时每个提示词抽取十张图像。 与 MultiDiffusion（Bar-Tal 等人，2023）类似，自启动方法在最初的 K 步中用背景潜在变量替换方框外的所有内容，使主体只能在方框内形成。 除非另有说明，使用方框时增益为 κ = 2，自启动覆盖最初 K = 15 步，且 s_lora = 0.7。 生成的适配器和注意力分支仅进入无分类器指导的条件通路，而无条件通路运行冻结的主干网络，因此指导会像对其他任何条件一样放大两者。 增益调度表和自启动各自覆盖去噪步骤最初的 30%。 背景潜在变量在十步中生成，且两个模块均关闭，因此它与场景一致，无需预渲染图像。 替换前，方框会先膨胀三个潜在单元。 自启动的替换掩码是二元的，因为混合两个噪声抽取会使输入在其时间步中噪声不足，并使输出饱和度降低。

paragraphs.en: Training one ten-concept sequence takes about an hour on a single NVIDIA GH200 for SD-1.5 and 5.5 5.5 to 7 7 hours for SDXL. On the same hardware, CIDM takes 1 1 hour 8 8 minutes to 1 1 hour 53 53 minutes for the same ten concepts, and its time per task grows along the sequence, from 7 7 minutes for the first task to 16 16 for the ninth. For generation, measured on one A100 with batch size 5 5 , 50 50 DPM-Solver steps and fp32, CIDM adds 45 % 45\% to the frozen backbone at T = 10 T=10 and 154 % 154\% at T = 37 T=37 , because every step runs all T T adapters. Our method adds 14 % 14\% at T = 10 T=10 , 37 37 and 100 100 alike, including one hypernetwork pass of 14 14 ms per generation. Generation times are medians over 12 12 batches. An evaluation sweep takes between 5 5 minutes and about 4 4 GPU-hours. All experiments ran on GH200 and A100 nodes. A replication of the inference protocol on a different cluster agreed with the original to within three of 84 84 samples on the placement metrics and to within 0.0015 0.0015 DINO per concept.
paragraphs.zh: 在单台 NVIDIA GH200 上训练一个包含十个概念的顺序，对于 SD-1.5 和 5.5 大约需要一小时，而对于 SDXL 则需要 5.5 到 7 小时。 在同一硬件上，处理相同的十个概念时，CIDM 需要 1 小时 8 分钟到 1 小时 53 分钟，并且其每任务所需时间会随着顺序增长：从第一个任务的 7 分钟增加到第九个任务的 16 分钟。 在生成方面，使用一台 A100、批量大小为 5、50 步 DPM-Solver 和 fp32 进行测量时，CIDM 在 T = 10 时使冻结骨干网络的时间增加了 45%，在 T = 37 时则增加了 154%，因为每一步都会运行所有 T 个适配器。 我们的方法在 T = 10 时使时间增加 14%，在 T = 37 和 T = 100 时分别增加 37% 和 100%，其中包括每次生成 14 毫秒的一次超网络遍历。 生成时间是基于 12 个批次的中位数计算得出。 一次评估扫描需要 5 分钟到大约 4 GPU 小时不等。 所有实验均在 GH200 和 A100 节点上运行。 在另一个集群上重复执行推理协议的结果与原始结果一致：在位置指标上，84 个样本的差异不超过 3；在每个概念上，DINO 的差异不超过 0.0015。

paragraphs.en: The training captions describe the scene around a concept but not the concept’s own attributes, such as its color or material. An attribute named in the caption competes with the adapter for carrying it. If every caption of the backpack says “red”, the text branch already accounts for the color, and the adapter has no reason to encode it. At inference the prompt is “a photo of backpack” and names no color. The backpack then comes out gray. Stripping the attribute from the captions moves the color into the adapter.
paragraphs.zh: 训练用的描述文本会描述某个概念周围的场景，但不会提及该概念本身的属性，例如颜色或材质。 描述文本中提到的属性会与适配器竞争承载该属性的任务。 如果背包的每段描述都说“红色”，那么文本分支已经考虑了颜色，适配器就没有理由再对其编码。 在推理阶段，提示是“一张背包的照片”，并未提及任何颜色。 此时生成的背包会是灰色的。 从描述文本中移除该属性后，颜色信息就会被转移到适配器中。

sents.zh: 训练用的描述文本会描述某个概念周围的场景，但不会提及该概念本身的属性，例如颜色或材质。

sents.en: The backpack then comes out gray.
sents.zh: 此时生成的背包会是灰色的。

sents.en: Stripping the attribute from the captions moves the color into the adapter.
sents.zh: 从描述文本中移除该属性后，颜色信息就会被转移到适配器中。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 tests this on the three concepts whose captions originally named an attribute, against a variant trained without the stripping. Both are evaluated with the bare prompt. Stripping raises identity on the duck toy and the backpack, whose captions all named the attribute. It leaves the cat unchanged, since only one of its five captions named it, and it leaves the seven concepts without an attribute unchanged. Across all ten concepts, DINO rises from 0.601 0.601 to 0.620 0.620 . The effect appears where the mechanism predicts it and nowhere else.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 在三个原本标题中标明了属性的概念上进行了测试，并与未经属性剥离训练的变体进行了对比。 两者均使用原始提示词进行评估。 属性剥离提升了鸭玩具和背包的识别度，因为它们的标题中都明确标注了该属性。 对于猫这一概念则没有变化，因为其五个标题中只有一个提到了它；同时，七个未标注属性的概念也保持不变。 在所有十个概念中，DINO 的得分从 0.601 0.601 上升到了 0.620 0.620。 这种效果仅出现在该机制能够预测到的情况下，其他情况则没有体现。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark provides one caption per image, and CustomConcept101 provides none. Training on the two together would confound the length of the sequence with a change of captioning regime. The captions for the ninety added concepts were therefore written from the images themselves, following the argument of Appendix E.1 . For each concept, all of its images were considered together. What stays constant across them (color, material, shape, markings, a face) was separated from what varies (where the object is, what it rests on, what is next to it), and only the latter was described.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试为每张图片提供一个描述，而 CustomConcept101 则不提供任何描述。 对两者进行联合训练会将序列长度与描述机制的变化混为一谈。 因此，新增的九十种概念的描述均根据图像本身撰写，遵循附录 E.1 中的论点。 对于每个概念，其所有图像都被一并考虑。 在这些图像中保持不变的部分（颜色、材质、形状、标记、人脸）与变化的部分（物体的位置、其支撑物、其相邻物体）被区分开来，并且仅对后者进行了描述。

The surroundings may be described, so 32 32 captions name an object that is also another concept of the sequence, most often a table. In three captions a content word directly precedes the class word, and in each case it describes a posture rather than an attribute ( a seated person , a stretching cat , a centered toy figure ). For evaluation we use the CIFC prompts and assign each added concept to one of its four categories.

paragraphs.en: We report three metrics. Text alignment (TA, CLIP text-image similarity) and image alignment (IA, CLIP image-image similarity) are the two the benchmark reports, and we use them to compare with published work. DINO ViT-S/16 similarity ( Caron et al., 2021 ) separates identities more finely, and we use it among our own runs, where no published numbers exist: for forgetting, ablations and placement. All three follow the CIFC evaluation script: CLIP ViT-B/32 with the CLIPScore scaling for TA, the mean cosine over all generated-reference pairs for IA, and the same DINO extractor.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了三项指标。 文本对齐（TA，CLIP 文本-图像相似度）和图像对齐（IA，CLIP 图像-图像相似度）是基准报告中的两项指标，我们使用它们与已发表的工作进行比较。 DINO ViT-S/16 相似度（Caron 等人，2021）能够更精细地区分身份，我们在自己的实验运行中使用了该指标，因为目前尚无已发表的数值：用于遗忘、消融研究和位置分析。 这三项指标均遵循 CIFC 评估脚本：TA 使用 CLIP ViT-B/32 和 CLIPScore 缩放；IA 使用所有生成-参考图像对的平均余弦相似度；DINO 提取器则保持一致。

Because a per-concept score read without its ceiling says more about the concept than about the method, Table 2 lists each score next to its ceiling. paragraphs.zh: 同一概念的不同参考示例之间已经存在差异。 它们两两 DINO 相似性的平均值范围从 0.42（绘画）到 0.91（dog2），在物体类别中则从 0.60 到 0.91；其中背包的相似度最低，因为其中一个参考示例显示它由人背着。 这一上限是数据本身的特性，并且对概念的分类几乎与我们的结果完全一致：某概念的上限与我们在该概念上计算的 DINO 值之间的相关性为 0.93（Spearman）和 0.97（Pearson），而 dog2 是唯一一个排名偏离的概念。 由于单独查看某个概念的分数而不考虑其上限，更多反映的是该概念本身而非方法特性，因此表 2 将每个分数与其对应的上限并列列出。 在 s lora = 0.45 时，我们的模型在物体类别上达到了上限的 0.82 到 0.98，在风格类别上则达到了 0.75 到 0.80。 剩余的差距位于权衡曲线之上。 在 s lora = 0.9 时，即同一曲线的恒等端点，同一个检查点在每个概念上都达到了上限的 0.90 到 1.01。 在该规模下，使我们的分数与上限产生差异的是有意舍弃的 TA，而非适配器本身无法达到的恒等能力。

We found subject amputation, canvas clipping and cut-out halos only by inspecting image grids, and none of them showed in the tables. paragraphs.en: Two things follow from the table. First, identity saturates at the high end of the scale. From s lora = 0.9 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.9 to 1.05 1.05 , IA gains only 0.27 0.27 , against 0.91 0.91 for the step before, and DINO falls from 0.663 0.663 to 0.655 0.655 . Raising the scale further adds no identity. Second, after fifty tasks the TA at a given scale moves by less than a point, while IA falls by four to six points and DINO by 0.05 0.05 to 0.08 0.08 . The model therefore loses identity at an unchanged TA.
paragraphs.zh: 表格中得出了两个结论。 首先，在标度的高端，身份特征趋于饱和。 当 s lora = 0.9 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.9 到 1.05 1.05 时，IA 仅增加 0.27 0.27 ，而前一步骤中增加了 0.91 0.91；DINO 则从 0.663 0.663 下降至 0.655 0.655 。 进一步提高标度并不会增加身份特征。 其次，在完成五十个任务后，给定标度下的 TA 变化不足一个点，而 IA 下降了四到六个点，DINO 则下降了 0.05 0.05 到 0.08 0.08 。 因此，模型在 TA 不变的情况下失去了身份特征。

paragraphs.en: It is not obvious that a generated adapter can be as good as a trained one. To test this, we train ten independent rank- 4 4 adapters, each directly on the frozen backbone, with the same data and the same text side as our recipe: no identifier token, the delta applied only at the class-word tokens, the same captions and augmentation, and 800 800 steps per concept. At inference, each adapter is selected by its task index. This control stores a separate adapter for every concept ( 0.40 0.40 M parameters each). Its storage grows with T T , but it cannot forget. At a common TA of 75.6 75.6 , ours at s lora = 0.45 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.45 , the control reaches an IA of 78.5 78.5 and a DINO of 0.594 0.594 , against 79.1 ± 0.3 79.1\pm 0.3 and 0.617 0.617 for the generated adapters (two seeds for the control, three for ours). Doubling its training to 1600 1600 steps per concept leaves it at 78.4 78.4 and 0.593 0.593 . The generated adapters therefore match independently trained ones on this benchmark, from a network whose size does not depend on T T .
paragraphs.zh: 生成的适配器能否与训练出的适配器一样出色，这一点并不明显。 为了验证这一点，我们训练了十个独立的秩为 4 的适配器，每个适配器都直接在冻结的主网络上进行训练，并使用与我们方案相同的数据和文本侧：没有标识符标记，增量仅应用于类-词标记，使用相同的图像描述和增强方法，以及每个概念 800 步。 在推理阶段，每个适配器通过其任务索引进行选择。 这种控制方法为每个概念存储一个独立的适配器（每个适配器占用 0.40 M 参数）。 其存储量会随 T 的增加而增长，但它不会遗忘。 在常见的 TA 为 75.6 时，我们的模型在 s_lora = 0.45 的情况下，控制方法达到了 78.5 的 IA 和 0.594 的 DINO，而生成的适配器则分别达到 79.1 ± 0.3 和 0.617（控制方法使用两个随机种子，我们的模型使用三个）。 将其训练步数翻倍至每个概念 1600 步后，结果仍停留在 78.4 和 0.593。 因此，在这个基准测试中，生成的适配器能够与独立训练的适配器相媲美，而其所基于的网络规模并不依赖于 T。

paragraphs.en: Since we trained CIDM on SD-1.5 only, we estimate its SDXL store from the structure of its SD-1.5 models. These adapt exactly the four cross-attention projections we adapt, at rank 4 4 , with nothing on self-attention, and each of the fifty concepts carries two tokens whose embedding is kept once per layer. The same structure on SDXL, with 70 70 cross-attention layers and a 2048 2048 -dimensional context, gives 3.14 3.14 M in low-rank factors and 0.29 0.29 M in embeddings, or 3.43 3.43 M per concept, against 191.1 191.1 M for our network. The two are equal at T = 56 T=56 , earlier than the 62 62 on SD-1.5. Applied back to SD-1.5, the same procedure returns 397,824 397{,}824 and 24,576 24{,}576 , exactly the two numbers its SD-1.5 models contain, which supports the estimate. If CIDM kept a separate embedding for each of SDXL’s two text encoders, its store would be larger and the crossing earlier still, so the assumption favors CIDM.
paragraphs.zh: 由于我们仅在 SD-1.5 上训练了 CIDM，因此我们根据其 SD-1.5 模型的结构来估算其 SDXL 存储需求。 这些部分恰好对应我们调整的四个交叉注意力投影，秩为 4×4，自注意力部分则没有任何调整；五十个概念中的每个概念都携带两个词元，其嵌入在每个层中仅保留一次。 在 SDXL 上采用相同结构，包含 70 层交叉注意力和一个 2048 维上下文，可得出低秩因子为 3.14M，嵌入为 0.29M，即每个概念为 3.43M；而我们的网络则需要 191.1M。 当 T = 56 时，两者相等，早于 SD-1.5 上的 62。 将相同方法应用于 SD-1.5，可得到 397,824 和 24,576，恰好与 SD-1.5 模型中包含的两个数值一致，这支持了上述估算。 如果 CIDM 为 SDXL 的两个文本编码器分别保留独立的嵌入，其存储需求会更大，交叉点也会更早出现，因此这一假设对 CIDM 更有利。

paragraphs.en: On SDXL-base-1.0 the branch and the training recipe transfer without a change of shape, giving 191.1 191.1 M parameters, 167.5 167.5 M of them across L = 280 L=280 adapted layers. One hyperparameter does not transfer. Carried over unchanged from SD-1.5, the regularizer weight β = 7120 \beta=7120 is more than twice as strong as this backbone needs and costs both axes of the trade-off at once. At s lora = 0.40 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.40 that run reaches only TA 72.1 72.1 , IA 76.4 76.4 and DINO 0.536 0.536 . Retuned to β = 3000 \beta=3000 , the same scale gives TA 75.5 75.5 , IA 80.1 80.1 and DINO 0.593 0.593 . paragraphs.en: Figure 8 places this run against the published SDXL rows. Each read at its own TA, the three-seed mean is ahead of five of the six baselines published in both tables: by 0.3 0.3 points of IA over C-LoRA, 0.6 0.6 over L2DM, 0.8 0.8 over EWC, 1.6 1.6 over LwF and 7.6 7.6 over sequential fine-tuning, with the first three inside the seed-to-seed spread. paragraphs.en: Three caveats bound this result. First, the thick curve in Figure 8 and the per-group variant below come from a single training seed. Of two further seeds, one lies above it and one below: at CIDM’s TA, they give image alignments of 79.0 79.0 and 74.9 74.9 , against 77.5 77.5 . The low seed shows no trade-off. Beyond s lora = 0.20 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.20 , raising its scale costs TA without adding IA, even with its weakest concept left out. We found no cause in the training setup or the data, and we report this backbone as the mean of three seeds without claiming that the recipe is stable on it. Second, this backbone is evaluated on the final model only, without a 55 55 -cell matrix, and forgetting is measured on SD-1.5 only. Third, the search behind β = 3000 \beta=3000 covered 300 300 to 7120 7120 on this backbone, while every other axis we swept made results worse: doubling the training budget to 1600 1600 steps, raising the learning rate to 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , narrowing the task embedding, and dropping the adapter on to ​ _ ​ out ​ .0 \mathrm{to\_out}.0 . The first of these cost 8 8 points of TA at every scale.
paragraphs.zh: 有三个注意事项限制了这一结果。 首先，图 8 中的粗曲线以及下方的每组变体都来自单个训练种子。 另外两个种子中，一个位于其上方，另一个位于其下方：在 CIDM 的 TA 测试中，它们给出的图像对齐分数分别为 79.0 79.0 和 74.9 74.9，而基准为 77.5 77.5。 低种子结果未表现出任何权衡关系。 当 s lora = 0.20 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.20 之后，继续增大其规模只会增加 TA 分数，而不会提升 IA 分数，即使排除了最弱的概念也是如此。 我们在训练设置或数据中均未发现任何原因，因此我们将该主干模型报告为三个种子的平均值，但并未声称这一方法在该模型上具有稳定性。 其次，该主干模型仅基于最终模型进行评估，未使用 55×55 的矩阵，且遗忘现象仅在 SD-1.5 上进行测量。 第三，β = 3000 \beta=3000 背后的搜索范围在该主干模型上覆盖了 300 到 7120，而其他所有我们调整的参数都会使结果变差：将训练步数翻倍至 1600、将学习率提高到 3 × 10^{-4}、缩小任务嵌入，以及移除 ​ _ ​ out ​ .0 \mathrm{to\_out}.0 上的适配器。 其中第一个调整在每种规模下都使 TA 分数下降了 8 分。

paragraphs.en: The curves above, like every number in this paper, apply a single scalar s lora s_{\mathrm{lora}} to all four adapted projections, but the four can be scaled separately. Giving the output projection to ​ _ ​ out ​ .0 \mathrm{to\_out}.0 its own scalar, held at 0.50 0.50 while the three projections that read the caption are swept, moves the whole front upward. paragraphs.en: Among the regularizer and embedding variants, only removing the regularizer costs more than the seed-to-seed threshold of 0.0091 0.0091 DINO. Tying the task embedding to the concept’s appearance preserves identity over three seeds but nearly triples forgetting. The lookahead step of Eq. 6 and placing the penalty on Δ ​ 𝐖 \Delta\mathbf{W} rather than on its factors show no measurable difference, and β \beta can be scaled by a factor of four in either direction without effect. Removing Gram–Schmidt has no measurable cost on these metrics over three seeds either. Its effect shows in how far old updates drift, which Appendix L measures in weight space. The order of the sequence does not matter: two random permutations of the ten concepts change DINO by at most 0.005 0.005 and forgetting by at most 0.0063 0.0063 , both within the threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 在正则化器和嵌入变体中，仅移除正则化器所导致的损失超过了 0.0091 0.0091 DINO 的种子间阈值。 将任务嵌入与概念的外观绑定，可在三种种子设置下保持身份一致性，但会使遗忘率几乎增加两倍。 公式 6 中的前瞻步骤以及将惩罚项施加于 Δ 𝐖 \Delta\mathbf{W} 而非其各因子上，均未表现出可测量的差异；β \beta 的值无论朝哪个方向调整四倍，也均无影响。 移除 Gram–Schmidt 过程在这些指标上，于三种种子设置下同样未产生可测量的额外损失。 其影响体现在旧更新偏离的程度上，附录 L 在权重空间中对此进行了测量。 序列的顺序并不重要：对十个概念进行两次随机排列，最多只会使 DINO 变化 0.005 0.005，遗忘率最多变化 0.0063 0.0063，两者均在阈值范围内。

paragraphs.en: Which layers are adapted is not merely a question of parameter budget. Retraining the reported recipe with to ​ _ ​ out ​ .0 \mathrm{to\_out}.0 removed from the adapted set, everything else unchanged, costs far more than the quarter of the parameters it saves. After ten tasks at s lora = 0.45 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.45 , DINO falls from 0.621 0.621 to 0.347 0.347 , image alignment from 79.5 79.5 to 68.9 68.9 , and TA from 75.3 75.3 to 68.7 68.7 . Raising the scale does not recover the loss ( 0.379 0.379 at 0.75 0.75 ). One concept, the dog, collapses entirely, but the remaining nine alone reach 0.389 0.389 at 0.45 0.45 , which shows that the drop is not caused by a single outlier. The same holds after fifty tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 哪些层被调整，并不仅仅是一个参数预算的问题。 用从调整后的集合中移除的 to ​ _ ​ out ​ .0 \mathrm{to\_out}.0 重新训练所报告的方案，其他一切保持不变，其成本远高于其所节省的参数量的四分之一。 在 s lora = 0.45 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.45 条件下完成十项任务后，DINO 从 0.621 降至 0.347，图像对齐度从 79.5 降至 68.9，TA 从 75.3 降至 68.7。 提高规模也无法恢复损失（在 0.75 时损失为 0.379）。 一个概念“狗”完全崩溃了，但仅凭其余九个概念在 0.45 时就能达到 0.389，这表明这种下降并非由单个异常值引起。 在完成五十项任务后，情况依然如此。

paragraphs.en: The ablation is equally costly on SDXL-base-1.0. DINO falls from 0.593 0.593 to 0.430 0.430 and image alignment from 80.1 80.1 to 72.1 72.1 , with the ablated variant evaluated at the best of three adapter scales, which shows that the effect comes from the construction rather than from the backbone it was designed on. TA is the only metric that does not drop there ( 75.5 75.5 to 76.0 76.0 ). This is what one would expect from removing a projection that writes into the residual stream: the model still follows the caption, but less of the concept appears in the image.
paragraphs.zh: 在 SDXL-base-1.0 上，消融实验的代价同样高昂。 DINO 的性能从 0.593 0.593 下降至 0.430 0.430，图像对齐性能从 80.1 80.1 降至 72.1 72.1；其中，经过消融的变体是在三种适配器规模中表现最佳者进行评估的，这表明该效应源于模型结构本身，而非其设计所基于的主干网络。 TA 是唯一在此情况下未下降的指标（从 75.5 75.5 升至 76.0 76.0）。 移除一个向残差流写入信息的投影层后出现这种情况是符合预期的：模型仍然遵循图像说明，但图像中体现的概念会减少。

paragraphs.en: We emphasize this point because Custom Diffusion ( Kumari et al., 2023 ) , a common per-concept adapter, adapts only to ​ _ ​ k \mathrm{to\_k} and to ​ _ ​ v \mathrm{to\_v} . A per-concept adapter can afford this because it is fitted directly. A hypernetwork that must generate the adapter does not have that freedom. The two projections that read the caption are token-masked and act on only a handful of positions, so without to ​ _ ​ out ​ .0 \mathrm{to\_out}.0 the generated update has too little of the residual stream left to write into.
paragraphs.zh: 我们强调这一点，是因为 Custom Diffusion（Kumari 等人，2023）是一种常见的每概念适配器，它仅对 ​ _ ​ k \mathrm{to\_k} 和 ​ _ ​ v \mathrm{to\_v} 进行适配。 每概念适配器可以直接拟合，因此具备这种能力。 而必须生成适配器的超网络则没有这种灵活性。 读取标题的两个投影经过了标记掩码处理，并且仅作用于少数几个位置，因此如果没有 to ​ _ ​ out ​ .0 \mathrm{to\_out}.0，生成的更新中可供写入的残差流就所剩无几。

paragraphs.en: Figure 9 summarizes the longer sequences of § 5 : (a) the storage of the fixed-size network against a store that grows with every concept, and (b) the ten CIFC concepts after ten and after fifty tasks as curves over the LoRA scale. Figures 10 and 11 show the same sequences as images, the first concept over fifty tasks and all ten concepts over ten. Read at full adapter strength instead of s lora = 0.45 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.45 , the first concept desaturates and develops texture artifacts from the tenth task on, and its DINO falls by 0.16 0.16 by the fiftieth. Of four further concepts measured the same way, three score higher at full strength by the fiftieth task. The scale trades identity against prompt fidelity differently for each concept, and the single scale we report is a compromise across them.
paragraphs.zh: 图 9 总结了 § 5 中更长的序列：(a) 固定大小网络与随每个概念而增长的存储之间的对比，以及 (b) 在十个和五十个任务后，十个 CIFC 概念随 LoRA 标度的变化曲线。 图 10 和图 11 以图像形式展示了相同的序列：第一个概念在五十个任务中的变化，以及全部十个概念在十个任务中的变化。 当以全适配器强度（而非 s lora = 0.45 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.45）读取时，从第十个任务开始，第一个概念会失去饱和度并出现纹理伪影，到第五十个任务时，其 DINO 值下降了 0.16。 在另外四个以相同方式测量的概念中，有三个在第五十个任务时，在全强度下获得了更高的分数。 对于每个概念，该标度都以不同的方式在身份特征与提示保真度之间进行权衡，而我们报告的单一标度是它们之间的折中结果。

paragraphs.en: This appendix examines the task embeddings: what tying them to appearance costs, how the updates they generate relate to one another, how far those updates drift along the sequence, and what the network generates away from the embeddings it was trained on.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录探讨了任务嵌入：将它们与外观成本相绑定会产生什么效果，它们生成的更新之间有何关联，这些更新沿着序列会漂移多远，以及网络在偏离其训练所用嵌入时会生成什么内容。

paragraphs.en: One ablation replaces half of the initial task embedding, 128 128 of its 256 256 dimensions, with a fixed projection of the mean CLIP image embedding of the concept’s reference photos, and keeps the rest of the recipe. Scored on its full 55 55 -cell matrix at s lora = 0.45 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.45 , it leaves identity unchanged over three training seeds ( 0.618 0.618 against 0.617 0.617 ) but raises forgetting to 0.016 0.016 , close to three times the reported value. Tying the task embedding to the concept’s appearance therefore gains nothing and costs stability, which is why we keep the task embedding arbitrary.
paragraphs.zh: 一种消融方法将初始任务嵌入的一半（即其 256 个维度中的 128 个）替换为概念参考照片的平均 CLIP 图像嵌入的固定投影，同时保留其余部分。 在 s lora = 0.45 时，基于完整的 55 单元格矩阵进行评分，该方法在三个训练种子中保持身份不变（0.618 对比 0.617），但遗忘率上升至 0.016，接近报告值的三倍。 因此，将任务嵌入与概念外观绑定既无收益又会损害稳定性，这正是我们让任务嵌入保持任意的原因。

paragraphs.en: We take the trained model and compute, for every pair of concepts and every adapted layer, the cosine between the generated updates, ⟨ Δ ​ 𝐖 ϕ , ℓ ​ ( 𝐯 i ) , Δ ​ 𝐖 ϕ , ℓ ​ ( 𝐯 j ) ⟩ F / ( ∥ Δ ​ 𝐖 ϕ , ℓ ​ ( 𝐯 i ) ∥ F ​ ∥ Δ ​ 𝐖 ϕ , ℓ ​ ( 𝐯 j ) ∥ F ) \langle\Delta\mathbf{W}_{\phi,\ell}(\mathbf{v}_{i}),\Delta\mathbf{W}_{\phi,\ell}(\mathbf{v}_{j})\rangle_{F}/(\lVert\Delta\mathbf{W}_{\phi,\ell}(\mathbf{v}_{i})\rVert_{F}\lVert\Delta\mathbf{W}_{\phi,\ell}(\mathbf{v}_{j})\rVert_{F}) , using the same r × r r\times r Gram matrices as in Appendix D , so that no Δ ​ 𝐖 \Delta\mathbf{W} is ever formed. Table 5 reports the mean absolute off-diagonal cosine. The updates of different concepts sit at 0.056 0.056 after ten tasks and 0.044 0.044 after fifty, compared with 0.27 0.27 for the 𝐀 \mathbf{A} factors that produce them and 0.001 0.001 for random matrices of the same shape. The closest pairs are the two cats ( 0.07 0.07 ) and a cat with a dog ( 0.06 0.06 ), and Figure 12 shows that no pair stands far above the rest. Nothing in the objective asks for this, and neither does the geometry of the inputs: retraining without Gram–Schmidt, that is, with random non-orthogonal embeddings, reproduces the same overall figures ( 0.056 0.056 at T = 10 T=10 and 0.043 0.043 at T = 50 T=50 , against 0.056 0.056 and 0.044 0.044 here), with every projection within 0.006 0.006 . Near-orthogonality of the generated updates therefore comes from the generator itself, and the orthogonalized inputs do not create it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用训练好的模型，为每一对概念和每一层适配层计算生成的更新之间的余弦值：⟨ Δ 𝐖 ϕ , ℓ ( 𝐯 i ) , Δ 𝐖 ϕ , ℓ ( 𝐯 j ) ⟩ F / ( ∥ Δ 𝐖 ϕ , ℓ ( 𝐯 i ) ∥ F ∥ Δ 𝐖 ϕ , ℓ ( 𝐯 j ) ∥ F )，其中采用了与附录 D 中相同的 r × r 格拉姆矩阵，因此从未生成任何 Δ 𝐖。 表 5 报告了平均绝对非对角线余弦值。 经过十次任务后，不同概念的更新值稳定在 0.056，经过五十次任务后则为 0.044；相比之下，产生这些更新的 𝐀 因子的值为 0.27，而相同形状随机矩阵的值为 0.001。 最接近的一对是两只猫（0.07），以及一只猫和一只狗（0.06）；图 12 显示，没有任何一对的值明显高于其余所有对。 目标函数中没有任何内容要求这一点，输入数据的几何结构也是如此：在不使用格拉姆-施密特正交化的情况下重新训练（即使用随机非正交嵌入），会重现相同的总体数值（T = 10 时为 0.056，T = 50 时为 0.043，而本文中的对应值为 0.056 和 0.044），且每次投影的差异都在 0.006 以内。 因此，生成的更新所呈现的近似正交性源于生成器本身，而非正交化的输入所导致。

paragraphs.en: On this measurement, the two embedding geometries do separate. At a lag of one task, the orthogonalized and non-orthogonalized runs are indistinguishable, with a ratio of 1.009 1.009 . The gap widens to 1.04 1.04 at a lag of twenty and 1.07 1.07 at forty-nine. paragraphs.zh: 在此测量中，两种嵌入几何结构确实分离了。 在延迟一个任务时，正交化与非正交化的运行结果无法区分，其比值为 1.009 1.009。 延迟二十个任务时，差距扩大到 1.04 1.04；延迟四十九个任务时，则扩大到 1.07 1.07。 因此，Gram–Schmidt 方法确实为生成的更新增加了稳定性，但这种影响很小，并且会随着序列长度的增加而累积，而非从一开始就存在。 最长的延迟平均仅涉及少数几对，在延迟四十九个任务时仅有一对，这也是该图中对这些数据点进行了阴影处理的原因。

paragraphs.en: During training, the hypernetwork only ever sees the task embeddings themselves, so we ask what it generates elsewhere in the embedding space (Figure 14 ). Generating along the line between two embeddings gives a smooth transition. Between two dogs, the identity morphs continuously rather than switching (third row). Between a dog and a cat, the class word determines the category and the embedding determines the identity within it. No point on the line mixes the two concepts, and the far end is a generic animal of the class the prompt asks for (first two rows, the same interpolation rendered once with each class word). Scaling one embedding acts like an adapter strength. At zero and at half the norm the model returns the class prior, and at the full norm the concept. At 1.5 × 1.5\times the image starts to break up, and at twice the norm it is noise. Five random vectors orthogonal to the whole basis, scaled to the median norm of the task embeddings, each produce a clean but generic instance of the class word, which shows that an unused embedding does no harm. These are inference-only probes, run with the localization branch off at s lora = 0.6 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 在训练过程中，超网络仅接触任务嵌入本身，因此我们探究了它在嵌入空间其他区域会生成什么（图 14）。 沿着两个嵌入之间的连线进行生成，可以实现平滑的过渡。 在两个“狗”之间，身份会连续变化，而不是突然切换（第三行）。 在“狗”和“猫”之间，类别词决定其所属类别，而嵌入则决定该类别内的具体身份。 这条线上的任何一点都不会混合这两个概念，而线的远端则是提示所要求类别的一个通用动物（前两行，使用每个类别词分别生成一次相同的插值结果）。 缩放一个嵌入的作用类似于调整适配器强度。 在零倍和半范数时，模型返回类别先验；在完整范数时，则返回具体概念。 在 1.5 × 1.5\times 时，图像开始破碎；在两倍范数时，则完全变为噪声。 五个与整个基正交且随机选择的向量，经缩放至任务嵌入的中位范数后，各自生成了一个类别词的清晰但通用的实例，这表明未使用的嵌入不会造成任何负面影响。 这些仅为推理探针，在运行时将定位分支设为 s lora = 0.6 s_{\mathrm{lora}}=0.6。

paragraphs.en: We repeat the test with nine small boxes on a 3 × 3 3\times 3 grid, each a third of the side, and with four elongated strips ( 0.35 × 0.9 0.35\times 0.9 and 0.9 × 0.35 0.9\times 0.35 ), after ten tasks and on three training seeds. The concept lands in the requested cell in 86 % 86\% of generations (chance 11 % 11\% ) and in the requested strip in 94 % 94\% (chance 25 % 25\% ). Placement is less precise than with quadrants. IoU is 0.565 0.565 and 0.570 0.570 , against 0.71 0.71 , and 74 % 74\% and 64 % 64\% of detected generations exceed IoU 0.5 0.5 . A small box is slightly overfilled (fill ratio 1.15 1.15 ), and a strip receives a subject of the right area that does not always take its shape (containment 0.83 0.83 ). Placement therefore follows boxes of other shapes and sizes, but matches their extent best at the size of a quadrant.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个 3 × 3 的网格上重复了这项测试，网格中有九个边长各为原边长三分之一的小盒子，以及四条长条（0.35 × 0.9 和 0.9 × 0.35），在完成十项任务后，并在三种训练种子条件下进行了测试。 在 86% 的生成中（概率为 11%），概念会落入指定的单元格；在 94% 的生成中（概率为 25%），则会落入指定的长条。 与使用象限时的情况相比，放置的精确度较低。 IoU 分别为 0.565 和 0.570，而此前的数值为 0.71；在检测到的生成中，有 74% 和 64% 的 IoU 超过了 0.5。 小盒子略微被过度填充（填充比为 1.15），而长条则接收了面积合适的主体，但该主体并不总能完全贴合其形状（包含率为 0.83）。 因此，放置过程会遵循其他形状和尺寸的盒子，但在与象限大小相当时，能最好地匹配它们的范围。

paragraphs.en: The output-space regularizer protects the generated adapters but not the placement tokens. paragraphs.en: Four further mechanisms were measured and rejected after the main design was fixed. Restricting the injection to coarse attention resolutions costs 16 16 points of IoU > 0.5 >0.5 and improves color by only 0.007 0.007 , so the finest layers take part in the layout. A penalty on the cross-attention logits of the concept’s tokens, applied at every image position outside the box, has no effect: 62 % 62\% , 64 % 64\% , 64 % 64\% and 65 % 65\% of generations reach IoU > 0.5 >0.5 at penalties of 0 0 , 3 3 , 6 6 and 10 10 . The text encoder is causal, so every token after the concept still carries it. Extending the penalty to the whole causal tail raises containment to 0.81 0.81 , against 0.67 0.67 for the branch alone, but in the one pair where TA was also scored it costs six points ( 80.7 80.7 to 74.6 74.6 ). The words that describe the scene come after the concept in the prompt and are suppressed along with it, which is why the method adds content inside the box and suppresses nothing. Isolating self-attention inside the box destroys placement (from 75 % 75\% to 4 % 4\% ), which shows that the region outside the box generates the subject independently.
paragraphs.zh: 在主要设计确定后，又测量并排除了另外四种机制。 将注入限制在粗注意力分辨率上会损失 16 个 IoU > 0.5 的分数，且颜色仅改善 0.007，因此最精细的层仍会参与布局。 对概念词元在图像框外每个位置上的交叉注意力 logits 施加惩罚并无效果：在惩罚值为 0、3、6 和 10 时，生成结果的 IoU > 0.5 的比例分别为 62%、64%、64% 和 65%。 文本编码器是因果的，因此概念之后的每个词元仍然携带该概念信息。 将惩罚范围扩展到整个因果尾部，可使包含率提升至 0.81（而仅对分支处理时仅为 0.67），但在唯一一对同时评估了 TA 的情况中，这导致分数下降了六点（从 80.7 降至 74.6）。 描述场景的词语在提示中位于概念之后，并会随其一同被抑制，这就是为什么该方法会在框内添加内容，而不会抑制任何内容。 隔离框内的自注意力会破坏位置准确性（从 75% 降至 4%），这表明框外区域是独立生成主体的。

paragraphs.en: Feathering the bootstrapping mask reduces detection to 74 74 of 84 84 generations and desaturates the outputs, for the reason given in Appendix C . The background that bootstrapping paints outside the box could instead be drawn from a set of images rendered in advance. On this benchmark, such a background contains the subject no better than the prompt-derived one ( 0.92 0.92 in both) and places it worse (IoU 0.63 0.63 against 0.73 0.73 , and 76 % 76\% against 90 % 90\% of generations above 0.5 0.5 ), because the scene it paints disagrees with the one the prompt asks for. It also requires that set of images at inference.

paragraphs.en: Because CIFC defines no protocol for scoring scenes with several concepts, this appendix reports our own mechanism on its own terms. We follow the region-based sampling of CIDM ( Dong et al., 2024 ) . At every step, each box is denoised with its concept’s prompt, the adapter generated for that concept and the placement module addressed by that box, and the region predictions are merged with a global one. In CIDM, each region is also helped by the token embeddings that CIDM learns for its concept at every layer. Our network keeps no per-concept tokens, so its regions rely on the generated adapter and the placement module alone. We run the eleven composite scenes of CIFC on SDXL, with four seeds each and one setting for all of them.
paragraphs.zh: 由于CIFC并未为包含多个概念的场景评分定义任何协议，因此本附录将基于我们自己的标准，独立报告我们设计的机制。 我们遵循CIDM（Dong等，2024）的区域化采样方法。 在每个步骤中，每个框都会使用其对应概念的提示、为该概念生成的适配器以及该框所关联的放置模块进行去噪处理，同时区域预测会与全局预测进行合并。 在CIDM中，每个区域还会得到CIDM在每一层为其概念学习到的词元嵌入的支持。 我们的网络不保留任何按概念划分的词元，因此其各个区域仅依赖生成的适配器和放置模块。 我们在SDXL上运行了CIFC的十一个组合场景，每个场景使用四个种子，且所有场景均采用统一设置。

sents.en: Because CIFC defines no protocol for scoring scenes with several concepts, this appendix reports our own mechanism on its own terms.

sents.en: We follow the region-based sampling of CIDM ( Dong et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 我们遵循CIDM（Dong等，2024）的区域化采样方法。

sents.en: At every step, each box is denoised with its concept’s prompt, the adapter generated for that concept and the placement module addressed by that box, and the region predictions are merged with a global one.
sents.zh: 在每个步骤中，每个框都会使用其对应概念的提示、为该概念生成的适配器以及该框所关联的放置模块进行去噪处理，同时区域预测会与全局预测进行合并。

sents.en: In CIDM, each region is also helped by the token embeddings that CIDM learns for its concept at every layer.
sents.zh: 在CIDM中，每个区域还会得到CIDM在每一层为其概念学习到的词元嵌入的支持。

sents.en: Our network keeps no per-concept tokens, so its regions rely on the generated adapter and the placement module alone.
sents.zh: 我们的网络不保留任何按概念划分的词元，因此其各个区域仅依赖生成的适配器和放置模块。

sents.en: We run the eleven composite scenes of CIFC on SDXL, with four seeds each and one setting for all of them.
sents.zh: 我们在SDXL上运行了CIFC的十一个组合场景，每个场景使用四个种子，且所有场景均采用统一设置。

paragraphs.en: The concepts become part of one scene rather than a collage. They share the lighting and drawing style of the background and sit at a plausible depth within it (Figure 16 ).
